exposure: type of place (related to residence/hospital type)
cohort: The study included 1849 women aged 15-49 from a nationwide population-based Turkish Demographic and Health Survey.
finding: Type of delivery, place of delivery, maternal age, and type of place were identified as variables with the highest impact on length of stay estimation after birth.
mod_finding: Type of delivery, an indicator of quality of birth care, was found to be a strong predictor of length of stay after birth.
